pages.title: Spell Staff
pages.text:
A mage's good companion, can store one spell. Spells stored in it only consume 80% mana when cast. Can also serve as a melee weapon if needed.

$(l)Usage:$()
Hold in main hand and right-click to open spell editing interface, after editing press Esc to bring up naming window, name it and click confirm (press Esc directly if not wanting to store)
Staff with spell stored can be right-clicked to cast. Place staff in offhand and right-click to remove the spell
